host_recommendations.host_quote: For the best Goan Fish Curry Rice near your stay, skip the tourist stalls and head straight to Souza Lobo. Ask for the catch of the day!
If it starts raining, my personal favorite spot is the Assagao Bakery cafe — best almond croissants and quiet wifi!

local_tips: Rainy afternoons in Goa are best spent exploring Fontainhas Latin Quarter or visiting spice plantations.
Baga Beach can get crowded between 4 PM and 7 PM; visit Quiet Vagator or Morjim for peaceful sunset views.
Renting a local scooter or using GoaMiles app is the most cost-effective local transport.
